## Definition of Done

- [ ] Every acceptance criterion is met and covered by a test
- [ ] Quality gates pass, including coverage, mutation and fuzzing thresholds where they apply ([quality gates](../docs/development/quality-gates.md))
- [ ] Reviewed against the review checklist
- [ ] Implemented from the specifications; no code or test data under incompatible licences, as required by the provenance rule in [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [ ] Documentation and rustdoc updated
- [ ] ADR added for any significant decision
- [ ] Intentional divergences from DSS recorded in `docs/design/divergences.md`
- [ ] Changelog fragment added under `changelog.d/`, or not needed (reason given above)
- [ ] Commits signed off
